## 主张 Claim

公开CuriGaze正式纳入75人、451试次的复算中，主动条件相对配对条件的目标注视变化差为−1.34个百分点，常规95% Welch区间为[−10.38,+7.69]；未建立保留优势或等效。它约束选择自动产生学习优势的经验对应。 / Reanalysis of the public CuriGaze inclusion sample, 75 participants and 451 trials, gives Curiosity−Yoked target-looking change of −1.34 percentage points, conventional 95% Welch interval [−10.38,+7.69]. It establishes neither a retention advantage nor equivalence, constraining an automatic selection-to-learning-advantage correspondence.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 按作者清理名单与试次表共同字段纳入；先在参与者内平均。77人的较早导出另存敏感性，不择行追随期望结论。 / Use the authors’ cleaned inclusion list joined to trial records, averaging within participants first. Retain the earlier 77-person export as sensitivity; do not select rows to fit a desired finding.
- 常规t/Welch区间以参与者独立为条件；配对身份未获得，顺序采样覆盖率未证明，参与者随机分配未确立。 / Conventional t/Welch intervals condition on participant independence. Pair identities are unavailable, sequential-design coverage is unproved, and randomized participant allocation is not established.
- 论文已知后的探索性二次分析；目标注视变化不是学习词数比例，也不独自识别概念理解、控制识别或保留机制。 / Exploratory secondary analysis after the paper was known. Change in target looking is not proportion of words learned and does not alone identify comprehension, recognized control or a retention mechanism.

控制、有效取得、保留和证据接纳是同一经历史中的不同作用关系。显示内容相同未证明保留输入相同；另一指点研究的积极结果不把跨研究差异识别为单一社会因果。 / Control, effective access, retention and evidence admission are distinct roles within one history. Matched displays do not establish equal retained inputs; a positive pointing comparison does not identify a single social cause across different studies.

## 检验与边界 Validation and boundaries

八个原始小文件与OSF哈希匹配；清理名单来自已验证压缩包。独立CSV/Decimal运算重构比例、参与者均值、方差、ANOVA及Welch算术，分布函数共用SciPy。作者实质反审完成，无独立agent验收或新Lean证明。 / Eight small originals match OSF hashes; the cleaned log comes from a verified archive. Separate CSV/Decimal calculations reconstruct proportions, participant means, variances, ANOVA and Welch arithmetic, sharing SciPy distribution functions. Substantive author counterreview completed; no independent-agent acceptance or new Lean proof.

不识别唯一心理机制、社会原因、长期记忆、意识或演化起源；75人主要分析与77人敏感性分开，区间不作顺序设计保证。 / Does not identify a unique psychological mechanism, social cause, long-term memory, consciousness or evolutionary origin. The 75-person primary analysis and 77-person sensitivity remain separate; intervals have no sequential-design guarantee.

- 区间容许正负差异，不足以认定等效；两人的名单遗漏原因与配对关系不明。原始轨迹未复算，论文表中SD差异和单值多重校正问题明示。 / Intervals admit positive and negative differences and cannot establish equivalence. Two log-omission reasons and pair mappings are unknown. Raw trajectories are not reprocessed; table-SD discrepancies and singleton multiple-adjustment code are disclosed. 既有条件连接保留；下一重点是在匹配发育程序中识别已取得访问及所保留来源／次序如何进入实际使用，分别观察当前依赖与旧内容认可。原典已约束自动迁移，但未识别唯一机制或演化史。 / Preserve the completed conditional connections. Next identify how formed access and retained source/order information guide actual use in a matched developmental procedure, distinguishing present reliance from old-content endorsement. Primary evidence constrains automatic transfer without identifying a unique mechanism or evolutionary history.
